clips.title: The story
paras: Guard Howe is a town guardsman stationed near the southern foot of the Lakeshire bridge in the Redridge Mountains. Driven by a personal vendetta against the Blackrock orcs encroaching on the valley, he offers bounties to any adventurer willing to cut down the invaders.

Positioned just south of the large stone bridge spanning Lake Everstill, Guard Howe stands watch over the heart of Lakeshire. Like many in the beleaguered town, he sees the encroaching Blackrock orcs as an existential threat to Redridge. Harbouring a bitter desire for revenge against the clan, Howe actively recruits passing mercenaries to hunt orcs in the eastern hills, offering pay in exchange for tangible proof of their defeat.
